scope: Preliminary complete construction and commissioning of rectangular cast-in-place reinforced-concrete potable-water valve chambers. The ordinary route accepts only chamber count and identity, internal dimensions, installed valve count and identity, nominal diameter and selected internal spool material. Excavation, reinforced-concrete construction, waterproofing, access components, pipework, fittings, supports, consumables, testing, labor, mechanisms, procurement balance and logistics are calculated from those primary facts and a visible editable engineering profile.
calculationPrinciples: outer dimensions and excavation are derived from internal dimensions, wall and slab thicknesses and working clearance
structural concrete, reinforcement, formwork, waterproofing, backfill and spoil are derived from primary chamber geometry
standard through-main spool, penetrations, puddle flanges, supports, dismantling joints and flange sets are derived from chamber and valve topology
labor and mechanisms follow calculated physical quantities and visible productivity factors
valve purchase is recalculated from installed count, retained spare, available stock and supplier package quantity
temporary shoring, groundwater dewatering and pavement reinstatement remain fail-closed conditional branches
exclusions: external distribution pipeline beyond the chamber wall
water-meter chamber, pumping station, reservoir or treatment plant
automatic inference of branch topology or valve duty from network length or capacity
claim that the preliminary profile is an approved universal norm or project design
